scientific_integrity: Two differently structured exhaustive checkers were executed against complete finite certificates. No statistical sampling, no infinite-family extrapolation, no independent scholarly assessment. Both checkers use the explicitly stated Fano incidence relation.
scientific_limitations: Fixed fourteen-vertex Fano incidence graph; theorem restricted to minimum closed-neighborhood identifying codes and to adjacency-restricted token slides. Results are finite exhaustive, with complete state and slide-edge certificates. Code cardinality and unrestricted one-token exchange geometry are previously known and not claimed as original. Historical priority of the slide-star decomposition could be affected by unpublished or unindexed computations.
title: The token-slide graph of minimum identifying codes of the Heawood graph is a star forest
